appliesWhen: The running Node is a different build from the snapshot's nodeVersion — i.e. the scheduled nightly/RC jobs only. The per-PR snapshot-check job installs the pinned version and ignores this file entirely, exemptions included.
scope: Only the exact flags named here are excused, and only in the listed direction. Any other added or removed flag still fails the job loudly, and a type/envVarSettings change is never excusable.
whyNotJustRefreshTheSnapshot: snapshot-check feeds snapshot.nodeVersion straight into setup-node, so absorbing a nightly's flag set would re-pin that deterministic gate to a nightly build. The snapshot stays pinned to a released Node; pre-release deltas live here until they ship.

--experimental-dtls.why: New v27-only experimental capability, unreleased. crates/nub-core/src/node/feature_matrix.rs carries no band for it, so nub never injects the flag — a capability nub does not claim needs no matrix entry.
--experimental-dtls.removeWhen: The snapshot moves to a released Node that carries the flag (v27.0.0 or later); the snapshot then records it directly and this entry is inert.

--experimental-repl-await.why: Dropped on the v27 dev line only. It still exists in every RELEASED Node — the newest, v26.5.1, diffs clean against this snapshot — so recording its absence in the snapshot would be factually wrong for every Node users run today. feature_matrix.rs never injected it, so there is no band to tighten.
--experimental-repl-await.removeWhen: The snapshot moves to a released Node that has dropped the flag (v27.0.0 or later).
